note: Reasoning cases for Deliberate (#459, docs/deliberate.md). Each has one right answer, checked against the final answer only: it must match `answer`, and when it also matches `wrong` (the tempting mistake), whichever comes first decides, so "Cara (Ben has the fish)" is right and "$0.10, I mean $0.05" is not. `solution` is the stub's reply. Written for this set.

cases.message: A bakery sells muffins for $3 each or 4 for $10. Maya buys exactly 10 muffins as cheaply as possible. How much does she pay?
A train leaves at 9:40 and the trip takes 2 hours and 35 minutes. At what time does it arrive?
Sam has twice as many marbles as Lee. Together they have 36. How many marbles does Sam have?
A shirt costs $40. It is discounted 25%, and then the sale price is discounted another 10%. What is the final price?
A rectangle's length is 3 times its width, and its perimeter is 48 cm. What is its area in square centimeters?
Three friends split an $87 bill equally, and each adds a $4 tip. How much does each friend pay in total?
A car uses 6 liters of fuel per 100 km. How many liters does it use for 350 km?
Ana reads 18 pages a day, starting on day 1. Her book has 250 pages. On which day does she finish it?
The average of five numbers is 12. Four of them are 10, 14, 9, and 15. What is the fifth number?
An empty 120-liter tank is filled at 8 liters a minute while a leak drains 3 liters a minute. How many minutes does it take to fill?
Jo is 4 years older than Kim. In 6 years, their ages will add up to 40. How old is Kim now?
What is 17% of 300 plus 23% of 300?
Alice, Ben, and Cara each have one pet: a cat, a dog, or a fish. Ben is allergic to fur. Alice's pet barks. Who has the cat?
All bloops are razzies. Some razzies are lazzies. Must some bloops be lazzies? Answer yes or no.
If it rains, the street gets wet. The street is not wet. Did it rain? Answer yes or no.
Five runners finish a race with no ties. Dan beat Eve. Fay beat Dan. Gus finished after Eve. Hal finished first. Who finished third?
Tom is taller than Jim. Jim is taller than Sue. Sue is taller than Ann. Who is the second shortest?
A drawer has 3 red, 4 blue, and 5 green socks. In the dark, how many socks must you take out to be sure of having a matching pair?
Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 100 days from today?
A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand, in degrees?

There are three boxes and one treasure. Exactly one of these statements is true: 1) The treasure is in box 1. 2) The treasure is not in box 2. 3) The treasure is not in box 1. Which box holds the treasure?
Mia has 3 sisters. Each of her sisters has 2 brothers. How many children are in the family?
In which country was the writer of the play with the character Ophelia born?
What is the chemical symbol of the element whose atomic number is one more than oxygen's?
How many years passed between the year the Berlin Wall fell and the year euro banknotes and coins came into circulation?
Which ocean lies between the continent Kenya is on and the continent Australia is on?
What is the number of sides of a hexagon plus the number of legs of a spider?
On which continent is the country whose capital is Lima?
In which century was the author of Pride and Prejudice born?
What is the atomic number of the element whose chemical symbol is Au?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?
If 5 machines make 5 parts in 5 minutes, how many minutes would 100 machines take to make 100 parts?
A patch of lily pads doubles in size every day. It takes 48 days to cover the whole lake. How many days does it take to cover half the lake?
How many months of the year have 28 days?
A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many sheep are left?
In a race, you overtake the runner in second place. What place are you in now?
Which is heavier: a kilogram of feathers or a kilogram of steel?
A doctor gives you 3 pills and tells you to take one every half hour, starting now. How many minutes until you have taken them all?
Divide 30 by one half, then add 10. What do you get?
